scope: Composed runtime closeout: preserved six-group main UI evidence plus verified Exit postconditions and focused hand-only session/replay recovery. The full main gesture loop was not rerun.

passedChecks: Active immersive session requires hand tracking, with both controllers disconnected and both hands available
The three-arena visit reaches explicit completion entirely through hand pinches, with no timer or controller
Home, mode previews, modal isolation and available/locked Chapters all work with hands and remain honest previews
All four arena images and the honest future replay view are reachable through hand-only Showcase navigation
Every settings category and actual comfort changes work with hands; Pause freezes Idle and Resume retains the exact page/preferences
Hand Confirm and Cancel choose distinct Home/Play destinations without a keyboard or controller

resolution.note: The initial raw failed report is preserved. Its Exit acknowledgement handling is fixed in the runner; successful application Exit and subsequent hand-only replay/reentry are established by separate named-state evidence, not by silently changing that raw report.

sessionChecks: The existing immersive runtime enters Home with hand tracking, both controllers disconnected, the real hero loaded and the known comfort preferences retained
Disconnecting both real emulated hands pauses and freezes Idle while preserving the Classic modal; reconnecting one hand requires an explicit hand Resume, then Cancel returns safely to Play/Home
The new Home Replay action restarts and completes all three arena steps through real Next/Finish/Back hand selections, without direct progress mutation
One real hand Exit ends the immersive session; the expected SDK ended-session acknowledgement is accepted only after inactive-session and entered=false postconditions, without retrying Exit
Exit/reentry preserves Home, exact comfort preferences and the same hero entity; final XR remains active with both controllers disconnected and both hand pinches explicitly released
limitations: Physical Quest tracking, comfort, cold start and GPU frame pacing are unmeasured.
Default direct-poke helper exceeded its 800ms contact window under software rendering; direct touch is not claimed as a passed runtime test.
